why: A hover rule reaches into the selected check's glyph layer. Issue #630's ruling keeps the check "distinct from focus/hover", and #392's contract keeps hover, focus and selected on separate properties; a pointer resting on the chosen control would now repaint the check itself. Killed by the guard that no rule keys a selectable's pseudo-element on :hover or :focus.
killedBy: hud.css: the selected check (issue #630) never keys the check on hover or focus, which keep their own properties
